title: Synchronize rules, personas, and tools documentation across project
summary: Synchronized authoritative agent rules, tool catalogs, and architectural invariants across .cvh/agents/cvh-dev/rules/ (tools.md, agents.md, boards.md), .cvh/agents/cvh-dev/persona.md, and AGENTS.md. Documented full authoritative standard tools catalog (advance_task/move_task with target_stage and summary, reject_task, subagent sync/async/collect, question/ask_user, todo_write, execute_command, read_file, write_file, edit_file, glob, grep, web_search, web_fetch). Formulated strict role boundaries prohibiting cvh-dev and development agents from calling create_task, create_tasks, or complete_task (reserved strictly for Root Orchestrator, users, and Sidecar Copilot). Documented Sidecar Copilot Dock architecture (CopilotDock.tsx, White Paper aesthetic, SQLite persistence under copilot:meta-chat, independent ReAct loop emitting copilot:stream), board self-healing subsystem (heal_task_board_and_column and heal_tasks), and the auto-gitignore runtime policy (ensure_cvh_scaffold appending .cvh/llm.json, llm.json, .cvh/worktrees/ to .gitignore).
commitMessage: docs(rules): synchronize tools catalog, copilot dock architecture, and self-healing rules
author: Lead Systems & Persona Architect (agent-developer)
